news.title: The most advantaged students attend the best-funded colleges. Does it have to be this way?
news.summary_en: The prevailing philosophy of American higher education is simple enough: The best-funded universities ought to be reserved for the best-qualified students, who are largely from advantaged backgrounds.

news.title: Expect the unexpected: Lessons learned from conducting online survey research
news.summary_en: Online surveys have become one of the most widely used tools in educational and social science research because they provide access to geographically dispersed populations, reduce data collection costs, and allow researchers to gather substantial amounts of information quickly.
